name: Live gateway pass, tool scoring corrected

questions.text: How many columns does this dataset have in total (including the label column)?
How many feature columns are there, excluding the class/label column?
What is the name of the label/target column?
Are the feature columns (f1...f617) numeric or categorical?
How many samples belong to class 6?
Which class has the fewest samples, and how many?
Is the dataset perfectly class-balanced (same number of rows per class)?
What is the standard deviation of column f1?
What is the mean value of column f10?
What are the min and max values of column f100?
What are the min and max values of column f10?
What are the min and max values of column f617?
How many rows have a value of f1 greater than 0?
What is the Pearson correlation coefficient between f1 and f2?
What is the average value of f300 for rows in class 20?

config_changes: re-score only, no new LLM calls

notes.problem: Tool appropriateness was penalised on three schema questions answered correctly without the tool.
notes.root_cause: golden_csv_dataset.json had needs_computation=true for schema_02, stat_mean_f10 and stat_range_f10.
notes.fix: Set needs_computation=false for those three and re-scored the same answers with no new LLM calls.
notes.result: Only tool appropriateness changed; answer correctness is unchanged.

config.execution_path: generate_stream() -> gateway_client.complete() -> LLM Gateway /query -> persistent pandas worker (module-level singleton, boots once at FastAPI startup via lifespan, self-healing on file-load and liveness)
config.sandbox_security: AST allowlist (ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES) + runtime SafeModuleProxy/SafeDataFrameProxy defense-in-depth + POSIX resource.setrlimit guarded for Windows dev
config.gateway_caching: Jina text-matching embeddings, semantic similarity threshold 0.90; disabled for any request where tools is not None OR is_tool_related is True
config.gateway_routing: sticky per-conversation provider (token bucket, Groq 30rpm/Gemini 15rpm), retry-with-backoff (2 attempts/provider) before fallback
config.data_cleaning: shared strip_stray_quotes() utility, used by both CSVExtractor._load() and the persistent worker's CSV load
config.schema_serialization: to_prompt_string() with THRESHOLD=20 truncation + dtype-grouped summary for remaining columns
config.scoring: deterministic numeric/range/string match (via compute_golden_value using golden_pandas_code) with LLM-judge fallback; word-boundary regex match for the non-tolerance string path (fixed from raw substring match, which risked false positives on short numeric golden values like single-digit class labels)
